modelNotes: Threes Board 1.0 uses season threes, last 5 threes, last 10 threes, three point attempts, attempt trend, expected minutes, minutes confidence, and usage.
Threes Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent three rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Towns (illness) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Pacers.
injury.detail: Towns missed Saturday's 97-96 win over Portland due to an illness, and that same ailment could force him to miss a second consecutive game. Andre Drummond got the start in Towns' place while James Wiseman saw a season-high 25 minutes off the bench. If Towns is forced to sit again Sunday, expect a similar approach for New York.

injury.shortComment: Siakam (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against New York.
injury.detail: Siakam has only missed one game this season, but he's in danger of sitting out Sunday due to left hip soreness. If the 32-year-old can't suit up versus the Knicks, Obi Toppin may move into the starting lineup.
